headers:
On Sheet B-4, Pay Item Notes, NOTE 4: It mentions a pay item 400-4-5 for pile head
removal repairs Concrete class IV . However I don't see a quantity nor a line item 400-
4-5 in the bid schedule. Please clarify?
sample:
Pay Item Note #4 on Sheet B-4 is removed and references to Pile Head Repair are
removed. Refer to the added attachment Structures Plans – Revised Sheet B-1 to
B4 found in the Attachments tab of Ion Wave.

headers:
Please define the scope of work required in each line item on the bid/proposal form?
Some of the line items are not clear as to the scope.
sample:
The objective is to return the condition of the fender system to functioning
condition and replace/repair missing/damaged elements on the fender system.
Please refer to the plans for details and scope of work. Contractor shall be
responsible for reviewing project site conditions prior to bid.

headers:
Plan Sheet B1-2 shows Install 2 Wraps and Install 1 Wrap. This is not shown on any
other plan sheets. Live Item 0455 76 has a quantity of 15 "Wrap Pile Clusters". Please
advise.
sample:
Proposed pile clusters shown on Sheet B1-2 also require wire rope wraps. Refer to
sheet B-4, Proposed Two-Pile Cluster detail. The proposed two-pile clusters each
require two wraps with a triple-wrapped wire rope. The estimated quantity for
455-76 Wrap Pile Clusters has been revised.
